user.title: Connect Zeekr
user.description: Enter the mobile number used by the Zeekr app. A verification code will be sent to that number.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Zeekr
reauth_confirm.description: Send a new verification code to the configured mobile number.

error.cannot_connect: Could not send or verify the SMS request. Check the connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: The verification code or account credentials were rejected.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Zeekr account is already configured.

find_vehicle.name: Find vehicle
find_vehicle.description: Flash the horn and lights so the vehicle can be located.

vin.name: Vehicle VIN
vin.description: Vehicle that should flash its horn and lights.

lock_doors.name: Lock doors
lock_doors.description: Lock every door on the vehicle.

vin.name: Vehicle VIN
vin.description: Vehicle whose doors should be locked.

unlock_doors.name: Unlock doors
unlock_doors.description: Unlock every door on the vehicle.

vin.name: Vehicle VIN
vin.description: Vehicle whose doors should be unlocked.

set_climate.name: Set climate
set_climate.description: Start air conditioning with a target temperature and run time, or stop it.

vin.name: Vehicle VIN
vin.description: Vehicle whose air conditioning should be changed.

enabled.name: Start climate
enabled.description: Turn on air conditioning. Clear it to turn it off.

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Target temperature in °C. Ignored when starting is disabled.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Run time in minutes. Ignored when starting is disabled.

set_seat_heating.name: Set seat heating
set_seat_heating.description: Start driver-seat heating with a level and run time, or stop it.

vin.name: Vehicle VIN
vin.description: Vehicle whose seat heating should be changed.

enabled.name: Start heating
enabled.description: Turn on seat heating. Clear it to turn it off.

level.name: Level
level.description: Heat level from 1 to 3. Ignored when starting is disabled.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Run time in minutes. Ignored when starting is disabled.

set_steering_wheel_heating.name: Set steering-wheel heating
set_steering_wheel_heating.description: Start steering-wheel heating with a level and run time, or stop it.

vin.name: Vehicle VIN
vin.description: Vehicle whose steering-wheel heating should be changed.

enabled.name: Start heating
enabled.description: Turn on steering-wheel heating. Clear it to turn it off.

level.name: Level
level.description: Heat level from 1 to 3. Ignored when starting is disabled.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Run time in minutes. Ignored when starting is disabled.

remote_control.name: Send raw remote control
remote_control.description: Send an unmodelled remote-control command to one Zeekr vehicle.

vin.name: Vehicle VIN
vin.description: Vehicle that should receive the command.

service_id.name: Service ID
service_id.description: App service identifier such as ZAF, RDL, RDU, RHL, or RSM.

command.name: Command
command.description: Command verb the service expects, usually start or stop.

parameters.name: Service parameters
parameters.description: Mapping of app service-parameter keys to values.
